authority: owner brief: 'Correct execution and instrumentation bugs within this batch when doing so preserves the frozen research contract.' Disclosed append-only; the frozen verdict is preserved.
trigger: frozen Stage A verdict NOT QUALIFIED: A5 per-replica binomial footprint z 5.16 (replica 1) > 5; all other gates (A1-A4, A6, A7, A9) passed and A8 qualified everywhere

diagnosis.replay: geometry-only replay of the frozen proposal stream reproduces every stored buried count exactly (analytic footprint and exclusion logic correct)
diagnosis.cause: the shared WL86/WL100 Dr.Jit PCG32 lane seeding (initstate per launch, initseq = lane) correlates proposals: adjacent-lane u1 corr -0.079 at lag 2, same-slot lag corr ~ -0.004 over 1,024 batch repeats; between-replica variance / binomial variance = 3.05 on partially covered sub-cells; a decorrelated lane seeding of the same proposal formula gives 1.14
diagnosis.mean: no bias: per-cell excess averaged over the 8 replicas is centred (mean z per cell -1.1 .. 1.25)
diagnosis.pixels: the same convention correlates camera pixels: block-mean variance / iid = 1.03-1.30 on the floor of the six F0 views

changes: A5 footprint test uses the 8-replica pooled excess with between-replica dispersion: |t| <= t_{7, 1 - 0.01/(2 m)} (m tested sub-cells); per-replica binomial z and overdispersion reported descriptively; underside, singular and mismatch tests unchanged

endpoint stream SE (Stages B, D, E) multiplied by sqrt(kappa), kappa = measured pixel block-mean variance ratio of the view (max over 2/4/8 px, floor region, >= 1): conservative, widens intervals only
unchanged: samples, seeds, tables, streams, thresholds, bands, arms, outcome and gate rules; no new rendering
blindness: designed and committed before any Stage B arm metric was opened (only stageA_gates.json and reference images were read)
